richiami.difetto: Steering may become notchy and if not corrected this could lead to the steering becoming stiffer and eventual loss of control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit an improved Dynamic Power Steering Unit and a software upgrade.
richiami.titolo: STEERING MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: When bringing the vehicle to a stop the clutch may remain engaged stalling the engine.  Once the engine is stalled it may not restart and the rear wheel could be locked. If this occurs the engine will stall and it will be hard to push the vehicle to a safe place as the rear wheel will be locked.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to update the centrifugal clutch assembly with new components.
richiami.titolo: CLUTCH MAY REMAIN ENGAGED STALLING THE ENGINE.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that an electrical short circuit to earth of the dynamic power steering (DPS) may occur. This can result in the vehicle suddenly steering to the left of it's own accord causing the driver to lose directional control.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the DPS system upgraded with new software which will alert the driver to the presence of a problem. Additionally disable the DPS in order to prevent any undesirable steering inputs.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL

richiami.difetto: Operator may need to exert a force greater than expected to initiate the turning of the steering handlebar in order to correct its trajectory.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected machines and re-program dynamic power steering system to improve smoothness of operation.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the rear brake caliper mounting bolts are too short. This can effect the rear brake caliper system integrity and may lead to partial or total dismounting of the caliper. Should this occur braking potential may be lost.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled machines will have the mounting bolts replaced.
richiami.titolo: REAR BRAKES MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE

richiami.difetto: Engine may fail to shut off when pulling the cord from the accessory tether engine shut off switch post.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and remove the tether engine shut off switch assy; along with it's cord.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY NOT SHUT OFF
